name: Metroid Fusion

assets.needs: Your own Metroid Fusion USA ROM (.gba or .zip), SHA-1 ca33f4348c2c05dd330d37b97e2c5a69531dfe87. No BIOS needed: the open Cult-of-GBA BIOS is bundled.
assets.location: Imported with 'Importar ROM' and stored at /data/data/io.github.genissonemilio.metroidfusion.albumtest/files/roms/fusion_usa.gba (root-only).
assets.notes: The app has no option to hide the touch controls. The opacity pref in fusion.xml can be set below the menu's 30 % minimum (15 % was used in testing).

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher buttons 'Imagem' (pixel mode) and 'Controles' (touch size, opacity, sound). The UI is in Portuguese.
settings.summary: Image: Pixel perfeito (sharp integer scaling) or Suave (Scale2x, the default). Touch controls size 80-130 %, opacity 30-90 %, sound on/off. Nothing else.

controls: Touch controls by default; controller input through SDL2. D-pad move, A/B actions, L/R secondary, Start map; the BSL Album (screenshot gallery) opens from the map with R.
display: Single screen, original aspect ratio with integer scaling (margins on some screens).
saves: /data/data/io.github.genissonemilio.metroidfusion.albumtest/files/saves/fusion.sav (32 KB SRAM, root-only); 'Exportar save' copies it out. Quick states from the in-game menu.
notes: Repo license shows NOASSERTION in the GitHub API (no recognised license file). Derived from the author's ZeldaMinishCapAndroid and MinishCapRecomp/gbarecomp. The package name ends in .albumtest; it is the 0.1.0 release (only release, 2026-10-29); Recompa lists it with one 'great' report on an AYN Thor.
verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs, sha1sum of a USA ROM. APK: jadx of FusionSetupActivity, RomImporter, GbaGameConfig; assets/payload/variants/fusion/game.toml. Web: GitHub search/API, Recompa index.
